verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — Saturday Night: BTC $60,024 Confirmed; All Gates Breached; NVDA Stop Day 1 Live; June 29 Is the Binary
verdict.rationale_short: A quiet Saturday with no US equity or KRX trading leaves the regime from Friday's close unchanged and every gate still breached. The night's only confirmed data point: Crypto.com MCP locked BTC's June 27 UTC daily candle at $60,024.33 — a lower close than the morning routine's partial read of $60,241.43 and $79 below the June 26 close. The shooting star reversal spread (session high $60,948 to close $60,024) widened to $924, the most bearish candle structure of the five-session distribution window. VIX confirmed at 18.41 (down 0.48 from Friday's 18.89 close — noise, not a clearing signal; still 1.41 pts above the 17 gate). SPX 7,354.02 and DXY 101.27 are unchanged from Friday. All three US-equity regime gates remain simultaneously breached for the sixth consecutive session. NVDA Stop Day 1 is active — the June 26 close of $192.53 was below the $195 two-close stop threshold — and June 29 (Monday) is the binary session: a close above $195 resets the stop; a close below $195 triggers mandatory full exit. SK Hynix's Nasdaq ADR listing (July 10, $29.4B, BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan underwriters) remains the sole confirmed structural positive from the weekend. The week of June 29 has three binary events in five sessions: NVDA stop resolution (June 29 close), NFP (July 2), and markets-closed gap (July 3). Do not add exposure before NVDA's stop resolves on June 29.

bear_case: Saturday confirmed what Friday signaled: the institutional selling overhang in mega-cap tech has not exhausted. BTC's June 27 UTC close of $60,024.33 — $217 lower than the morning partial read — is the cleaner bearish signal. The shooting star ($924 high-to-close reversal spread) at $61,000 resistance means sellers are present well below the $62,000 re-entry gate. The $60,024.33 close is only $24 above the $60,000 psychological floor — a gap-down opening June 29 from any negative catalyst (weak Asian markets, NVDA stop trigger, surprise Fed commentary) could breach $60,000 for the first time since early 2026. The equity regime is equally sober: six consecutive sessions with all three gates breached (SPX below 7,460, VIX above 17, DXY above 100); the Nasdaq is down ~3% on the week with active tech selling overcoming both the largest passive buying event in Russell history ($334B reconstitution, June 26) and the oil disinflation macro tailwind. NVDA's stop Day 1 clock adds a structural binary to Monday's session — if June 29 closes below $195, the forced long exit removes the primary institutional buy-side support from the order book and structurally increases supply overhang into the NFP week. The NFP on July 2 — with markets closed July 3 — is the worst possible macro context for unresolved stop risk: a strong print (+200K, wages +0.4%) into a 3-day holiday gap arrives when longs who held through the NVDA stop trigger can only exit at the July 7 open, potentially at materially worse levels. Escalation threshold: SPX below 7,300 on any Monday close converts the regime from STEP ASIDE to BEARISH and would require reassessing all long positions. Invalidation: SPX closes above 7,460 AND VIX closes below 17 simultaneously — STEP ASIDE reverts to HOLD. NFP prints Goldilocks (+130–180K, wages +0.2–0.3%) — regime conditions stabilize and the June 29–30 quarter-end window dressing creates a recovery setup.
